SELECT m.match_num AS matchNum, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS matchDate, m.match_time AS matchTime, m.home_score AS homeScore, m.away_score AS awayScore, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, hc.club_name AS homeClubName, hc.club_logo AS homeClubLogo, ac.club_name AS awayClubName, ac.club_logo AS awayClubLogo FROM Match m LEFT OUTER JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Club hc ON ma.clubOwner_key = hc.clubOwner_key LEFT OUTER JOIN Club ac ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = ac.clubOwner_key
AND
ORDER BY m.match_date DESC, m.match_num DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM Match m LEFT OUTER JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Club hc ON ma.clubOwner_key = hc.clubOwner_key LEFT OUTER JOIN Club ac ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = ac.clubOwner_key
AND

SELECT NVL(COUNT(c.clubOwner_key), 0) FROM Club c WHERE c.club_status = 1
AND INSTR(c.club_name, #{kwd}) > 0

SELECT c.clubOwner_key, c.club_name, c.club_logo, NVL(COUNT(am.match_num), 0) AS totalGames, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN am.result_text = '승' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS winCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN am.result_text = '무' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS drawCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN am.result_text = '패' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loseCount, NVL(SUM(am.gf), 0) AS goalsFor, NVL(SUM(am.ga), 0) AS goalsAgainst, NVL(SUM(am.gf - am.ga), 0) AS goalDifference FROM Club c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ma.clubOwner_key AS clubOwner_key, m.match_num, m.match_date, m.home_score AS gf, m.away_score AS ga, CASE WHEN m.home_score > m.away_score THEN '승' WHEN m.home_score = m.away_score THEN '무' ELSE '패' END AS result_text FROM Match m JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id WHERE m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND m.away_score IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT ma.clubOwner_key2 AS clubOwner_key, m.match_num, m.match_date, m.away_score AS gf, m.home_score AS ga, CASE WHEN m.away_score > m.home_score THEN '승' WHEN m.away_score = m.home_score THEN '무' ELSE '패' END AS result_text FROM Match m JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id WHERE ma.clubOwner_key2 IS NOT NULL AND m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND m.away_score IS NOT NULL ) am ON c.clubOwner_key = am.clubOwner_key WHERE c.club_status = 1
AND INSTR(c.club_name, #{kwd}) > 0
GROUP BY c.clubOwner_key, c.club_name, c.club_logo ORDER BY (NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN am.result_text = '승' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 3 + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN am.result_text = '무' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) DESC, NVL(SUM(am.gf - am.ga), 0) DESC, NVL(SUM(am.gf), 0) DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT result_text FROM ( SELECT m.match_date, m.match_num, CASE WHEN (ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} AND m.home_score > m.away_score) OR (ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey} AND m.away_score > m.home_score) THEN '승' WHEN m.home_score = m.away_score THEN '무' ELSE '패' END AS result_text FROM Match m JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id WHERE (ma.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} OR ma.clubOwner_key2 = #{clubOwnerKey}) AND m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND m.away_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.match_date DESC, m.match_num DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT m.match_num AS matchNum, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS matchDate, m.match_time AS matchTime, m.home_score AS homeScore, m.away_score AS awayScore, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, hc.club_name AS homeClubName, hc.club_logo AS homeClubLogo, ac.club_name AS awayClubName, ac.club_logo AS awayClubLogo FROM Match m LEFT OUTER JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Club hc ON ma.clubOwner_key = hc.clubOwner_key LEFT OUTER JOIN Club ac ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = ac.clubOwner_key WHERE TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth}
AND (INSTR(hc.club_name, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(ac.club_name, #{kwd}) > 0)
AND ( TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = #{kwd} OR TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{kwd} )
ORDER BY m.match_date ASC, m.match_time ASC
